name: Starlight ☆ Idol -Colorful Top Stage!-
original_name: すたーらいと☆アイドル -COLORFUL TOP STAGE!-
source:
Yuuichi is a producer-in-training who is entering his third year at Mion Gakuen, a school created to find and develop talent for arts and entertainment. As is the custom, he was put in charge of an idol group: the prominent 5-person idol unit CRESCENT. However, the members are all peculiar in their own ways. Even though they each have great individual ability, there was no group unity. He seeked to solve their worries with the help of his best friend Kazutoshi and Katou-sensei, so that the girls can both mature individually and develop together as a group. Their goal is to perform on the biggest final stage ‘live alive’.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Yuuichi是一名实习制作人，即将在Mion Gakuen读三年级，这是一所旨在寻找和培养艺术和娱乐人才的学校。按照惯例，他被任命负责一个偶像团体：著名的五人偶像团体CRESCENT。然而，成员们都有自己独特的方式。尽管他们每个人都有很强的个人能力，但没有团队的团结。他试图在最好的朋友一俊和加藤老师的帮助下解决她们的烦恼，让女孩们既能个体成熟，又能作为一个群体共同发展。他们的目标是在最大的决赛舞台“livelive”上表演。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/10/14/october-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
